verdicts.title: VS-Net: Voting with Segmentation for Visual Localization
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Visual localization is of great importance in robotics and computer vision. Recently, scene coordinate regression based methods have shown good performance in visual localization in small static scenes. However, it still estimates camera poses from many inferior scene coordinates.
